plugins.name: procedures
plugins.description: Procedural knowledge system: /how-do-i, /update-records (+templates), /am-i-done, the how-do-i/am-i-done gate hooks with turn-state wiring, and the evolve-sweep Stop hook that dispatches post-turn record evolution.

plugins.name: worklog
plugins.description: One JSONL line per turn telling the turn's story — requests, outcomes, mistakes — each entry anchored to transcript uuids with a quote sliced out of the cited line's own body. A Stop hook that never blocks: detaches, claims the turn atomically, fails open with a recorded reason.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Delegation machinery: /delegate routes a task shape to a specialist from the host's own agent roster, /create-new-sub-agent mints one when none fits (template + linter).

plugins.name: about-my-person
plugins.description: One curated file tracking who your person is + the /about-my-person maintenance procedure.

plugins.name: take-note
plugins.description: Daily working notes: /take-note scratchpad + SessionStart daily-note loader.

plugins.name: recall
plugins.description: Conversation history: /recall searches a SQLite FTS5 index over past session transcripts and synthesizes what you were doing into the current session.

plugins.name: just-recipes
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to prefer named just recipes over ad hoc shell, using just's native discovery/introspection features.

plugins.name: heartbeats
plugins.description: Cron jobs as unit files: /heartbeats renders a directory of markdown units into one marker-delimited managed block of the crontab, and diffs, drift-checks, or installs it behind an explicit approval flag.
